name: QES
recent: QES 完成了向 Ray Tech Singapore 发行 83,276,260 股新股（占 10%）的私募，每股 RM0.53，新股已于 2026 年 9 月 22 日上市。公司同时以 SGD5.47 million（约 RM17.49 million）收购新加坡两间办公室单位。最新季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收环比增长 35.3%，净利环比增长 89.5%。
notable: 完成向 Ray Tech Singapore 发行 83,276,260 股新股（10%），每股 RM0.53，新股已于 2026 年 9 月 22 日上市。
以 SGD5.47 million（约 RM17.49 million）收购新加坡两间办公室单位。
2026 年 9 月 11 日召开特别股东大会，股东通过上述私募议案。
risks: 私募新股占已发行股份 10%，对现有股东持股比例有摊薄影响。
Ray Tech Singapore 及 Unicomp Technology 出现大股东权益申报（Section 137），反映股权结构变动。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 RM78.835 million，环比增长 35.3%，同比增长 1.9%；净利为 RM7.009 million，环比增长 89.5%，同比增长 58.2%；净利率为 8.9%，高于上一季度的 6.3%。

recent_en: QES completed a private placement of 83,276,260 new shares (10%) to Ray Tech Singapore at RM0.53 per share, with the shares listed on 22 September 2026. The company also acquired two office units in Singapore for SGD5.47 million (about RM17.49 million). In the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 35.3% QoQ and net profit rose 89.5% QoQ.
notable_en: Completed issuance of 83,276,260 new shares (10%) to Ray Tech Singapore at RM0.53 per share, listed on 22 September 2026.
Acquired two office units in Singapore for SGD5.47 million (about RM17.49 million).
Held an EGM on 11 September 2026 where shareholders approved the private placement.
risks_en: The private placement of new shares representing 10% of issued shares has a dilutive effect on existing shareholders.
Notices of interest by Ray Tech Singapore and Unicomp Technology (Section 137) indicate a change in shareholding structure.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM78.835 million, up 35.3% QoQ and 1.9% YoY; net profit was RM7.009 million, up 89.5% QoQ and 58.2% YoY; net margin was 8.9%, higher than 6.3% in the previous quarter.
